videos.title: LifeVal: Measuring AI progress on the tasks that matter in everyday life.
videos.description:
For AGI to benefit all of humanity, it should help people with the everyday tasks that matter most to them. 

So we built LifeVal, a new benchmark shaped by feedback from thousands of ChatGPT users on where they most want help from a personal assistant—from finding childcare to accessing government services and managing personal finances.

Over the past year, we’ve used LifeVal to measure and improve how well our models handle these everyday tasks.


https://openai.com/index/lifeval/

videos.title: How Salesforce uses Claude Code
videos.description:
Salesforce scaled Claude Code to thousands of engineers and doubled effective output, with fewer bugs per line of code than before.

Engineering leaders from Salesforce explain how they measure AI coding ROI with an "effective output" score built with Stanford researchers, and how an agent maturity curve moved engineers from simple prompts to autonomous agents across the software development life cycle. They also cover a decades-old codebase made headless in weeks instead of a year, a marketplace for sharing agent skills, incident agents that find the right team automatically, and a bug that Claude Opus tracked down in 24 hours after human attempts failed.

More here: https://claude.com/office-hours#salesforce

videos.title: Stamina Nightblade Solo Build | ESO Update 51
videos.description:
Pure Class Stamina Nightblade (StamBlade) Solo Build for ESO Update 51. The build gets great mitigation from An Eye for Exploitation, especially in execute, and good sustain from Siphoning Attacks. Soul Harvest gives it insane Ultimate generation, while Killer's Blade gives it a fast execute.

This setup cleared Solo Moon Hunter Keep and Solo March of Sacrifices with 3 Misfortunes, and parses 65.3k DPS on the 6 million dummy, going up to 77.3k in the Full Damage setup. An older setup also soloed Veteran Hard Mode The Cauldron and Veteran Frostvault.

Works for all kinds of solo content - overland at any Challenge Difficulty up to Vestige, World Bosses, Maelstrom Arena, Vateshran Hollows, early arcs in Infinite Archive, and Veteran Dungeon soloing.
